years.tagline: 5th grade — robotics, basketball, and giving back.

events.body: Helped design a robot attachment that sorted cargo blocks by color. Our team won the design award at the regional qualifier and presented our engineering notebook to judges.
Averaged the most assists on the team and kept a notebook of plays we ran in practice. Coaches named me MVP for leadership and hustle.
Read 25 books in three weeks and collected pledges from family and neighbors. Donated $500 to our school library for graphic novels and STEM kits.
Built a car with my dad, sanded the axles, and learned to measure weight distribution. Finished 2nd in my den and helped younger scouts tune their cars.
Built a mini skee-ball game from cardboard boxes and rubber bands. Demonstrated it at the school maker fair and explained the lever we used for the launcher.
